note: Remote Bridger-Teton NF campground on Hobble Creek at the Lake Alice trailhead (Lake Alice is a 1.5-mile hike), about 80 miles and two hours from Kemmerer by WY-232 and gravel forest roads FS-10062 and FS-10193. Stock corrals; a general campground, not horse-only. Toilet open in summer. --Claude
